description: Test suite for channel target helper functions in a messaging or Slack integration context, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: ensureTargetId
methods.description: Validates that the candidate string matches the provided pattern and returns it; throws an error with a custom message if it does not.

methods.name: requireTargetKind
methods.description: Checks that the target object has the specified kind and platform, returning the target id if valid; throws an error otherwise.

methods.name: buildMessagingTarget
methods.description: Constructs a messaging target object with specified platform, id, and kind.
